subject: general
question: For how many days, is the Karaga Utsav depicting the religious heritage and rich culture of Karnataka celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Karaga festival is celebrated in the state of Karnataka.**
 
• This Festival is one of the **oldest festivals in Karnataka** with a hi**story of over 300 years.**
 
• The festival is celebrated **annually in march or April (Chaitra Month according to the Hindu Calander).**
 
• The** festival runs for 11 days **and is a celebration of rituals and traditions that have their origin in the epic Mahabharata, particularly in the stripping of Draupadi.
